context: Write two limericks for moms about how hard it is to get their kids to do chores. Be angry about it. Separate your two limericks with six asterisks (******).

trace.content:
My son says, "Mom, I'll do the dishes,"
But then he runs to grab his dishes.
He claims that they are clean,
So I have to clean again,
And scream until my voice is thin.

******

My daughter says, "I'll sweep the floor,"
Then trips right in the middle door.
She says it's just a trick,
To make me feel sick,
So I'm furious and I roar!
